content: In addition to Sankey diagrams between our MS clusters and the hand-coded categories, we also provide a complementary visualisation as heatmaps of normalised contingency (z-score) tables, e.g., Fig. 4 . This allows us to compare the relative association of content clusters to the external categories at different resolution levels. A quantification of this correspondence is also provided by the $NMI$ score introduced in Eq. ( 8 ).
